newsitem.title: UK: Linden capitalised at 22.8 mln stg in flotation.
newsitem.headline: Linden capitalised at 22.8 mln stg in flotation.

text.p: Regional UK house-builder Linden Plc said the placing of its shares at 150p per share will capitalise the company at 22.8 million stg.
Linden said this represented a multiple of 11.7 times forecast pro-forma earnings per ordinary share of 12.8p for the year ending December 31.

The company said the flotation will raise around 6.5 million stg before expenses of which 4.6 million stg will be raised for the company and 1.9 million stg represents sales by institutional shareholders, directors and senior managers.
The float was sponsored by Credit Lyonnais Laing. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
